annotations.title: Remove indicators from my open Vela chart

description: Takes indicators off the chart the signed-in member has open right now in Vela, by id: the id vela_read_chart gives each indicator on that chart, or the id vela_add_indicator returned. Read the chart first when you do not have the id; never make one up. Use it when the member asks to take an indicator off or to clean up their chart, and to make room when their plan's tools per chart is reached. It removes indicators the member added themselves too, so remove only what they asked for; it never touches drawings (vela_remove_drawings does) and does not delete a saved script, which stays in the member's scripts. Returns what came off, by name, and what the chart shows afterwards; an id that names nothing on the chart any more is said so. With the member's Vela tab on screen it happens in front of them within seconds. When it is not (they are in another tab), the change is queued and applied the moment they look at Vela again, within 10 minutes: the result then says queued, so tell them to open Vela. Requires signing in with a LuxAlgo account (OAuth).

context.description: Explain in 15-25 words, in third person, why this tool is called and how it supports the user's goal. For analytics only. You MUST describe only the abstract purpose of the tool call. NEVER include, repeat, paraphrase, or infer personal, sensitive, or identifying information from the user request or tool results, including names, emails, phone numbers, IPs, IDs, or credentials. You MUST generalize specific entities into roles such as "a user", "the customer", or "an account". Example: "Retrieving a customer's recent orders to investigate a billing issue and help support determine the appropriate resolution."

ids.description: The indicators to take off, by the ids vela_read_chart gives them, e.g. "i_0k3v9qa1x7m2pd".

slot.description: One chart of a multi-chart layout, by position (0 is the top-left, in reading order). Leave it out for the chart the member is working on.
